description: This file implements a WebSocket server using the libwebsockets library, including handling HTTP requests, WebSocket connections, and dynamic handler registration within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: WebSocketServer
classes.description: A class that manages WebSocket and HTTP server operations, including connection handling, request processing, and handler registration.

methods.name: InitializeLwsObjects
methods.description: Initializes the libwebsockets context, protocols, and mounts, setting up SSL if certificates are provided.

methods.name: RegisterHandlerFactory
methods.description: Registers a static handler factory for a specific URI path.

methods.name: RegisterDynHandlerFactory
methods.description: Registers a dynamic handler factory for a specific URI path.

methods.name: Serve
methods.description: Starts the server loop, handling incoming connections and requests.

methods.name: WebsocketCallback
methods.description: Static callback dispatching to instance method for WebSocket events.

methods.name: DynHttpCallback
methods.description: Static callback dispatching to instance method for dynamic HTTP requests.

methods.name: DynServerCallback
methods.description: Handles dynamic HTTP requests, including GET, POST, OPTIONS, and body processing.

methods.name: ServerCallback
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection events such as establishment, closure, message reception, and writable events.

methods.name: InstantiateHandler
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket handler based on the URI path.

methods.name: InstantiateDynHandler
methods.description: Creates a dynamic handler based on the URI path.
